fact: Between July 2023 and April 2024 RITA's birth, death, marriage and divorce registration services were made available digitally through eRITA, and its births and deaths system was linked to health systems (DHIS2, GoTHoMIS) and nine government bodies.
title: Hotuba ya Bajeti ya Wizara ya Katiba na Sheria kwa Mwaka wa Fedha 2024/25
